tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool, near-white paper. Shonin is light-only.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, menus: anything that sits on paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, hashes, input backgrounds on raised surfaces, the track of a gauge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. 3.1:1+ on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: the navy of the wordmark. On paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (15:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, axis ticks, the lockup tagline’s blue-grey; on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk, brand-soft and neutral-soft (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand blue, taken from the logo. Primary actions, links, focus and the share-price line. As text on paper, paper-raised or brand-soft (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand text: the attested-build panel, selected rows, brand notices.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button label). White on the brand blue (6.4:1).

tokens.name: mark-deep
tokens.usage: Logo palette: the deep navy of the mark’s shadowed corners and core.

tokens.name: mark-mid
tokens.usage: Logo palette: the mark’s main blue (the same value as brand in light).

tokens.name: mark-bright
tokens.usage: Logo palette: the electric blue of the mark’s lit faces.

tokens.name: mark-sky
tokens.usage: Logo and illustration only: the cyan highlight at each fold of the mark. Under 3:1 on light paper, so never text.

tokens.name: hero-ground
tokens.usage: Marketing hero only: the near-black navy of the wordmark, the far edge of the hero’s radial glow (mark-mid → mark-deep → hero-ground).

tokens.name: hero-ink
tokens.usage: Headline and primary-button fill on the hero ground. 18:1 on hero-ground, 16:1 on mark-deep.

tokens.name: hero-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrow, lead text and secondary-button border on the hero. 10.8:1 on hero-ground, 9.2:1 on mark-deep; keep it off the bright top-right of the glow.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive returns and the “looks fine” rating. A teal, apart from the brand blue and off the red/green axis. As text on paper, paper-raised or gain-soft (5:1+). Always paired with a + sign or up arrow.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind gain text (rating pills, positive chips).

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative returns, “serious concerns”, destructive actions, killed or frozen vaults. As text on paper, paper-raised or loss-soft (5.2:1+). Always paired with a − sign, down arrow or icon.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind loss text: danger notices, serious-concern pills.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: “Some concerns”, low tank, retiring, pending claims. As text on paper, paper-raised or caution-soft (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind caution text: caution notices and pills.

tokens.name: caution-fill
tokens.usage: Solid amber fill of a low tank gauge. Only 2:1 on light paper, so it never carries meaning alone: the gauge always prints its runway in words. Text on it is on-caution.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on caution-fill (8:1).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral badges and the “couldn’t tell” rating; ink-muted or ink text on it.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of brand, underlined in running text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, 2px off the control. 5.4:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (retire, kill confirmations): an alias of loss.

tokens.name: chart-price
tokens.usage: The share-price line on charts.

tokens.name: chart-mark
tokens.usage: The dashed high-water-mark line and chart axis text.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Decorative.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger button hover and pressed. White on it 8.1:1.

tokens.name: hero-hover
tokens.usage: Hero primary button hover. hero-ground on it 15.0:1.

tokens.name: hero-tint
tokens.usage: Hover ground of the hero secondary button and nav items on navy. Decorative.

tokens.name: hero-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on navy: the footer's bottom rule. Decorative.

tokens.name: hero-edge
tokens.usage: Borders of the social link tiles on navy. Decorative.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Table row hover. ink 16.4:1, ink-muted 6.8:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Link-card hover border. Decorative.

tokens.name: brand-edge
tokens.usage: Border of a selected chip on brand-soft. Decorative.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button text on paper-sunk (4.1:1). Disabled controls are exempt; keep them legible.

tokens.name: skeleton-shine
tokens.usage: The moving highlight of a loading skeleton. Decorative.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets; the content behind is inert.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold: the headline voice, closest in spirit to the heavy geometric wordmark. Headlines, hero statements and agent names only; never body copy, labels or numbers in tables.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The home hero headline only. Larger than display-xl; tablet and phone step down to 56/60 and 44/48.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline on the home page and campaign pages. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles: an agent’s name on its page, a section landing title.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: Can I get out whenever I want?
styles.usage: Section headings on marketing and docs pages; the question-led headings.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Sub-section headings on marketing pages and docs; feature titles.

styles.name: agent-name
styles.usage: Agent names in tables, rows and cards.

groups.name: Serif
groups.note: Newsreader for reading: long-form text on docs and marketing pages, and the Reviewer’s own words. Its figures are tabular, so numbers inside prose line up and stay legible.

styles.name: display-quote
styles.sample: Rebalances two perpetuals so the vault earns funding without holding a view.
styles.usage: The Reviewer’s summary of an agent, and pull quotes. Italic marks words that are someone’s reading, not ours.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: A vault’s money is always in one of two places: at home, or trading.
styles.usage: Body text of docs, articles and explainers. Measure 60–70 characters.

styles.name: reading-s
styles.sample: The profit fee is only charged on new profit.
styles.usage: Long-form text in narrow columns, captions under figures, footnotes in docs.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk for the app: everything a person reads to act. Its figures are tabular by default, so numbers line up in tables.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, app section headings.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Sub-sections inside a card; table titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: You can ask for your money back at any time.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs on marketing and docs pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If there isn’t enough cash at home, your withdrawal is booked.
styles.usage: Default running text and UI copy.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Priced a few seconds after you ask.
styles.usage: Help text under fields, table cells in dense tables, footnotes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels over stats and field groups (set text-transform: uppercase). Never for sentences.

styles.name: hero-statement
styles.sample: Reviewed code, running in an attested machine, trading with keys that can’t withdraw your money.
styles.usage: The line under the home headline, in hero-ink on navy.

styles.name: hero-lede
styles.sample: Write an agent in Rust and publish it for a flat $1.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph on a marketing hero, in hero-ink-muted.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels: 14 small, 15 medium, 16 large.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation items.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Route and panel tabs.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips, pills and badges.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Numbers are the product. Set money and returns in these, tabular, never in the display serif.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline number of a page: share price, a vault’s value.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Stat tiles.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers inside tables and summary rows.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a person might copy and compare: hashes, addresses, code, config keys.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hashes, addresses, file names, inline code.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Hashes inside chips and table cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; inline gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small); table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding; form field gaps; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, rating pills, inputs’ inner wells, hash chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, notices.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Gauges, progress tracks, status dots, the attestation disc.

shadow.note: Shonin is flat: surfaces are told apart by paper tones and hairlines. One shadow, for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the wallet sheet, toasts. Never on cards sitting in the page.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card edges, table rules, dividers (line colour).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (line-control colour).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn in focus with a 2px offset.

motion.note: Quiet and fast. Nothing overshoots or bounces; money never animates. prefers-reduced-motion removes movement entirely.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour, icon swap, tooltip fade.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, tab underline, toggle knob.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, toasts, Exit panel tab switch.

tokens.name: dur-page
tokens.usage: Page transitions, chart range morph, scrollytelling swap.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals, hero copy.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Chart and hero line draws.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Most state changes and exits.

tokens.name: ease-emph
tokens.usage: Entrances: reveals, sheets, draws, the seal.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Ambient loops that reverse.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between items revealed together.
